context: Tests the third state of the operator-setup design-tool gate: not installed at all (vs. installed-but-not-enabled, covered by a sibling eval). The agent must distinguish 'never installed' from 'installed but disabled', prefer agent-first setup, run dependency/smoke setup, add the marketplace by absolute path, install the plugin, reverify, and never hand-roll the rebrand as a substitute.

checklist.name: Stops rather than proceeding
checklist.description: The agent does not proceed into design-token work; it stops and reports the plugin is unavailable before doing any rebrand work.

checklist.name: Correctly identifies not-installed (not just disabled)
checklist.description: The agent's explanation reflects that the plugin was never installed — it does not say the plugin is 'already installed, just enable it' or otherwise imply install-then-enable is unnecessary.

checklist.name: Guides agent-first clone/dependency/smoke setup
checklist.description: The agent prefers setup it can run: use or clone https://github.com/Adobe-AEM-Foundation/aem-experience-catalyst.git, run npm run install:all inside resources/plugins/aem-excat-plugin/excat-marketplace, and smoke-check excat/tools/excatops-mcp with npx . before install.

checklist.name: Guides absolute marketplace-add + install
checklist.description: The agent tells the operator to add the marketplace using an absolute path to <clone>/resources/plugins/aem-excat-plugin/excat-marketplace and install with /plugin install excat@excat-marketplace; it does not rely on a relative path for Claude Code.

checklist.name: Requires restart/reverify
checklist.description: The agent says to restart if needed and reverify with /plugin list and claude skill list before continuing.

checklist.name: No hand-rolled rebrand
checklist.description: The agent does not edit styles.css, sweep hardcoded colors, or rewrite content itself as a substitute for the design skill.

checklist.name: Rebrand phase left blocked
checklist.description: The rebrand phase is not marked done and no design-tokens-applied/asset-colors-swept/content-register-rewritten step is marked done.
